neet_phy_u01_t00_1.working: A light year is the distance light travels in one year, so it is a unit of distance.

neet_phy_u01_t00_2.working: n1*u1 = n2*u2, so 50u = n*(2.5u), giving n = 20.

neet_phy_u01_t00_4.working: A is true because n is proportional to 1/u. R is false because the magnitude nu is the same in every unit system; only the numerical value changes.

neet_phy_u01_t00_5.working: 1 Å = 1e-10 m and 1 fm = 1e-15 m, so 1 Å = 1e5 fm, not 1e3, making I false. II is the definition of the parsec, about 3.08e16 m, so II is true.
